simple.meaning: נוּעַ (nûwaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to waver , in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 42 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 4:12. Its contexts include kingship, mountain, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נוּעַ (H5128).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נוּעַ (nûwaʻ) / H5128 is traced through Genesis 4:12, Genesis 4:14, Exodus 20:18, Numbers 32:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to waver , in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
